title: SwiftUI Metrics
description: Schema for the 'SwiftUI' key inside the unified review-output metrics object.

value.description: SUI-1: max @ViewBuilder nesting depth in body and all view-returning computed properties
SUI-1: count of distinct view expressions (Text, Image, HStack, ForEach, etc.) — modifiers excluded
SUI-2: count of methods/computed properties classified as IMPURE (data fetch, transform, format, validate, compute)
SUI-3: highest number of chained modifiers on any nested child view inside a @ViewBuilder closure
SUI-4: how the ViewModel dependency is injected — 'protocol' (compliant), 'concrete' (violation), 'none' (no VM present)
SUI-5: count of file-scope views/types only referenced from #Preview or PreviewProvider
SUI-6: count of file-scope View structs with no #Preview or PreviewProvider instantiation anywhere
SUI-7: count of container views with .accessibilityIdentifier but missing .accessibilityElement(children:)
SUI-8: count of .frame() calls with literal numeric width or height values
SUI-9: count of types/protocols with @MainActor that have background-safe members or nonisolated escape hatches
